title: Resumable storage migration workflow
description: copy -> verify size/hash -> metadata cutover; resumable, idempotent, per-object status, source retained until explicit cleanup. Docs closeout requirement: this issue may not be closed until the documentation surfaces it affects are updated (relevant ADRs, architecture/product docs, implementation contract, README, CLAUDE.md as applicable) and the docs build passes.
close_reason: createStorageMigrationService({db, backends, addJob}) + storage.migrate-object task (packages/storage/src/migration.ts). startMigration creates storage_migrations (running) + per-object storage_migration_objects (pending) rows and enqueues one jobKeyFor-deduped job per object (test proves re-enqueue does not duplicate: graphile job count stays N). Each job: copy by stable key -> verify destination size + sha256 RE-HASHED from a streamed destination read -> transactional metadata cutover (media_objects.storage_backend_id) + status done; source object never deleted by the job. cleanupMigrationSources(migrationId) is the separate deliberate call: refuses while incomplete, deletes only done objects whose metadata verifiably points at the destination, returns {deleted, skipped, failures}. getMigrationStatus returns counts by status. Resumability proven in test/migration.test.ts against real Graphile Worker with local source -> real RustFS S3 destination: enqueue with no processor, run slowed worker, graceful stop after >=2 done (pending>0 verified), restart with real task -> completed, all 8 objects done with attemptCount=1 (no duplication), byte/sha256-intact on destination, source retained until explicit cleanup. Failed-verification path: tampered source object -> copy fails sha256 verify -> bad destination copy removed, object row failed with mismatch error recorded, verifiedAt null, NO cutover (media row still on source), migration completed_with_errors, cleanup skips it. Docs: copy->verify->cutover->explicit-cleanup semantics recorded in phase-0-foundation.md; docs:build green.
